name: sydney-sweeney-strawberry-photorealism
image_vibe: Soft intimate luxury studio with blonde waves, pale pastel styling, and innocent strawberry-playful energy
image_purpose: Create a high-end multi-panel beauty and fashion editorial concept.

prompt.project_info: A multi-panel 2:3 photorealistic studio beauty editorial of an original adult blonde model in a warm off-white cinematic setting.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with voluminous blonde bombshell waves and a deep side part, soft natural skin with visible pores and fresh radiance, rosy cheeks, peach-pink balm lips, smudged brown eyeliner, voluminous lashes, and natural brows. She wears an ivory, pale baby-blue, or soft-cream form-fitting mini dress with structured bustier seam details and thin straps.
prompt.composition_elements: Panel architecture includes a top-left extreme close-up focused on the lips and lower face while eating a strawberry with an innocent playful bite, and a top-right eye-level thigh-up medium shot leaning slightly toward camera with relaxed shoulders. Maintain clean warm off-white studio background, soft reflector fill, and clear multi-panel hierarchy.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Large front-left softbox with soft reflector fill from the right, dewy highlights on cheekbones, nose bridge, cupid's bow, and shoulders, clean cinematic intimate luxury atmosphere, soft ethereal finish.
prompt.technical_specs: 2:3 portrait editorial, macro and medium panel variations, 85mm portrait lens for medium panel, macro lens for close-up, shallow depth of field, realistic skin, hair, knit, strawberry, and studio texture, subtle film grain, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-end 2:3 multi-panel photorealistic studio beauty editorial featuring an original adult woman with voluminous blonde waves and a deep side part, soft natural skin with visible pores and fresh radiance, rosy cheeks, peach-pink balm lips, smudged brown eyeliner, voluminous lashes, and natural brows. Dress her in an ivory, pale baby-blue, or soft-cream form-fitting mini dress with structured bustier seam details and thin straps. In the top-left panel create an extreme close-up with a slight low angle focused on the lips and lower face as she takes an innocent playful bite of a strawberry, with an ultra-shallow depth of field. In the top-right panel create an eye-level thigh-up medium shot with the subject leaning slightly toward camera and relaxed shoulders. Use a seamless warm off-white studio backdrop, large front-left softbox, right-side reflector, dewy highlights on cheekbones, nose bridge, cupid's bow, and shoulders, realistic skin and hair, cinematic intimate luxury mood, subtle film grain, and no text or watermark. Use an original face and do not imitate a public figure.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, identifiable public-figure likeness, sexualized framing, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed strawberry, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text

assets.name: source blonde strawberry panel editorial
assets.usage: Use only as optional guidance for blonde waves, pastel mini dress, strawberry close-up, panel arrangement, warm off-white studio, and softbox lighting; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the adult original subject, two-panel composition, strawberry action, blonde hair, pastel dress, warm studio, and soft beauty lighting. Identity and non-essential panel details may vary.

changes: Removed the named public-figure identity and replaced it with an original adult subject.
Replaced sensual strawberry wording with an innocent playful action while retaining the visual concept.
